name: lookout
description: A little office beside your Claude Code session: what Claude is doing, drawn as an animated pixel scene over the plain facts (tools, diffs, tests, context, an API cost estimate). Follows this session, or a headless claude -p worker

log.title: Log path
log.description: Path of the stream-json log to follow (~ allowed; demo or session also work). Empty: LOOKOUT_LOG, then the first source, then ./logs/worker-current.jsonl when it exists, else this session

sources.title: Named sources
sources.description: Named logs, each name=path (e.g. local=~/logs/worker-current.jsonl); /lookout <name> switches. A single comma-separated string is read too

scene.title: Scene
scene.description: The animated scene at the top of the pane: office (the sidebar), office-hd (the same room at four times the density), or observatory (a quiet sky). controlroom and aurora were retired and read as office-hd and observatory

sceneSize.title: Scene size
sceneSize.description: How tall the scene is drawn: compact, standard, or large (for layouts that give the scene more room)

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: The colours the scenes and modules paint with: night (dark terminals, the default), paper (light terminals), or phosphor (a one-colour green CRT)

season.title: Season
season.description: What the office window shows: auto (follows the date), winter, spring, summer, autumn, or none (plain night sky)

ambience.title: Ambience
ambience.description: Slow decorative loops in the scenes that mean nothing (rain on the glass, steam off a mug, a lamp breathing, the cat asleep): on (the default) or off (the scenes as they were drawn before)

layout.title: Pane layout
layout.description: calm: the scene over what Claude is doing in plain words, its thinking and the run so far; detailed: the scene and a grid of instrument modules over every text block (on a wide pane the modules flank a large scene); ambient: the scene alone, filling the pane. classic, panel and wall were retired and read as detailed

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Module ids for the detailed layout, in order (see README); unknown ids are skipped

server.title: Model server
server.description: Model-server adapter; auto probes the URL and picks the first that answers

serverUrl.title: Model server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the model server. Empty: each server's own default port (8080 llama.cpp and mlx-serve, 8000 vLLM, 11434 Ollama, 1234 LM Studio)

serverLog.title: Model server log
serverLog.description: Path of the model server's log file (mlx-serve reads per-request stats here)

compare.title: Compare cost against
compare.description: Which API model the cost estimate is priced at; off shows no money

customPrices.title: Custom prices
customPrices.description: in,out,cacheWrite,cacheRead in $/Mtok, used when compare is custom

stallSecs.title: Stall after (s)
stallSecs.description: Seconds without log movement while waiting on the model before the pane says stalled

handoffFile.title: Handoff file
handoffFile.description: File whose first line the orchestrator strip shows as the task; empty: <log basename>.handoff.md beside the log

background.title: Scene background
background.description: terminal: scenes leave their background unpainted so the terminal's own colour shows through; scene: scenes paint their own walls and floors

tool.title: Register the status tool
tool.description: Registers mcp__lookout__status so the orchestrating model can check the worker

explain.title: Thinking in plain words
explain.description: off (the default): the thinking stays on this machine, shown as its locally worked-out gist. session: also ask a small model (haiku, through this session's own API client) to say this session's thinking again in plain words. all: workers' thinking too, which then leaves the machine

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Toasts and/or a status-line entry for failing tests, stalls and the run finishing
